_comment: Provenance for every executable App Lab redistributes out of internal/lsp.
One entry per component in versions.json. `download_licenses.sh` turns this into
the committed texts in internal/notices/licenses/, which ship in every dist;
`check_licenses.sh` fails the build if the two drift apart or if a component
in versions.json has no entry here.
`text_url` placeholders, resolved against the version pinned in versions.json:
`text_member` marks `text_url` as an archive to extract that member from,
rather than a file to download directly.

arduino-cli.note: Copyleft. Upstream ships this same text inside the release archive; artifacts.go keeps it next to the extracted binary.

arduino-language-server.license_name: GNU Affero General Public License, version 3
arduino-language-server.note: Copyleft. Unlike arduino-cli the upstream tag carries no 'v' prefix. Upstream ships this same text inside the release archive; artifacts.go keeps it next to the extracted binary.

clangd.note: Covers the clangd binary and the clang-resource/ headers shipped beside it. arduino/clang-static-binaries only rebuilds LLVM and carries no license file of its own, so the text comes from llvm-project at the matching tag: the pinned version 22.1.8-2-rc2 is LLVM 22.1.8 plus an Arduino build revision, hence {version_base}.

ctags.note: Copyleft, and we patch it. build_ctags.sh applies one mechanical rename (__unused__ -> CTAGS_UNUSED) so it compiles against a modern macOS SDK; that script plus the pinned commit are the complete corresponding source. macOS arm64 only.

node.spdx: MIT AND Apache-2.0 AND BSD-3-Clause AND ISC
node.license_name: Node.js license (MIT) with bundled third-party notices
node.note: Node's LICENSE is itself an aggregate: Node's own MIT grant followed by the notices for everything statically linked into the binary (V8, OpenSSL, ICU, zlib, llhttp and more). It has to ship whole; the SPDX expression above is indicative, the file is authoritative.

basedpyright.note: Shipped as a node_modules tree run by our bundled node. Its own dependencies keep their individual LICENSE files inside that tree, which we archive intact.

typescript-language-server.note: Shipped as a node_modules tree run by our bundled node. Its own dependencies keep their individual LICENSE files inside that tree, which we archive intact.

typescript.note: Installed alongside typescript-language-server, which needs a tsserver to drive.

vscode-langservers-extracted.note: Provides the HTML and CSS language servers, repackaged from MIT-licensed VS Code sources. Shipped as a node_modules tree run by our bundled node.
